about: Tiny is a township on the southern shore of Georgian Bay in Simcoe County, Ontario—not a city. Beaches at Balm Beach and Woodland Beach, French-Canadian Lafontaine heritage, and cottage shoreline share the landscape northwest of Midland and Penetanguishene. About 13,000 people live in Tiny Township.
